emotional_tone: uncompromising security, elite precision, and calm control
key_features: Master Password verification and Zero-Knowledge local encryption simulation for vault items
Secure Vault Item Management (Passwords, API Keys, Secure Notes, Credit Cards, Custom Values)
Client-side search, filtering by category (Login, Secure Note, API Key, Card), and favorite items
Password Generator with entropy score, symbols, and length controls
Vault Security Health Audit (Weak, Reused, Expired passwords & breach simulation)
Secure Encrypted Item Sharing with custom expiry & password protection
Emergency Account Recovery Flow (Recovery Kit PDF download & secret backup codes)
Export Vault Data (JSON or Encrypted file download) and Single Item export/copy
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a world-class secure vault and password manager SaaS app with both landing/auth pages and a gorgeous dashboard. Ensure all interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, search bars, copy actions, export buttons, and modals include proper data-testid attributes. Use Sonner for toast notifications. Ensure zero hardcoded placeholder URLs. Adhere strictly to Tailwind CSS styling and design system rules.
